entries.en: Arean carried the folded table through the narrow side entrance.
entries.zh: 阿雷安把折叠桌从狭窄的侧门搬了进去。

entries.en: She kept the postcard from Arecibo inside her travel journal.
entries.zh: 她把从阿雷西博寄来的明信片夹在旅行日记里。

entries.en: Areeda found a dry cloth to wipe the rain from the bench.
entries.zh: 阿里达找来一块干布，准备擦掉长椅上的雨水。

entries.en: Areen put the loose photographs between two sheets of cardboard.
entries.zh: 阿伦把散放的照片夹在两张硬纸板之间。

entries.en: Aref kept the unpainted shelves in the garage overnight.
entries.zh: 阿里夫把尚未上漆的架子放在车库里过夜。

entries.en: Arel moved the clock away from the edge of the mantelpiece.
entries.zh: 阿雷尔把钟从壁炉台边缘挪开了。

entries.en: Arellano found a shorter route through the park on the way home.
entries.zh: 阿雷利亚诺回家时找到了一条穿过公园的更短路线。

entries.en: Aren kept the spare bicycle pump beside the garden gate.
entries.zh: 爱伦把备用打气筒放在花园门旁。

entries.en: Arenal repaired the broken latch before the children returned from school.
entries.zh: 孩子们放学回来之前，阿雷纳尔修好了坏门闩。

entries.en: Arenberg packed the glass bowls separately from the metal pans.
entries.zh: 阿伦贝格把玻璃碗与金属锅分开装好。

entries.en: Arend placed a newspaper beneath the dripping flowerpot.
entries.zh: 阿伦德在滴水的花盆下面垫了一张报纸。

entries.en: Arendt kept one drawer empty for the visitor's belongings.
entries.zh: 阿伦特空出一个抽屉，用来放客人的随身物品。

entries.en: The chemistry student compared an arene with a nonaromatic hydrocarbon.
entries.zh: 化学专业的学生比较了一种芳烃与一种非芳香烃。

entries.en: The geologist examined the arenite beneath a hand lens.
entries.zh: 地质学家用手持放大镜观察那块砂碎屑岩。

entries.en: Arensberg set the small ladder on the level paving stones.
entries.zh: 阿伦斯伯格把小梯子放在平整的铺路石上。

entries.en: The old book's chapter on areography included several hand-drawn maps.
entries.zh: 那本旧书描述火星表面的章节中附有几幅手绘地图。

entries.en: Her project in areology compared two sets of images of Mars.
entries.zh: 她的火星学项目比较了两组火星图像。

entries.en: He wrapped the warm arepa in a napkin before taking it outside.
entries.zh: 他用餐巾包好热乎的阿瑞巴玉米饼，再拿到外面。

entries.en: Arer put the muddy spade away from the freshly washed tools.
entries.zh: 阿雷尔把沾泥的铁锹放到远离刚洗净工具的地方。

entries.en: Areva left a spare cushion on the chair beside the window.
entries.zh: 阿雷瓦在窗边的椅子上留了一个备用坐垫。

entries.en: Arey kept the repaired radio on a shelf above the workbench.
entries.zh: 阿里把修好的收音机放在工作台上方的架子上。

entries.en: An argala stood motionless beside the shallow water.
entries.zh: 一只鹳类鸟站在浅水边，一动不动。

entries.en: The program printed argc before processing the command-line arguments.
entries.zh: 程序先打印命令行参数个数，再处理这些参数。

entries.en: Arge folded the tarpaulin after the last delivery had arrived.
entries.zh: 最后一批货物送到后，阿尔该叠好了防水布。

entries.en: Argelia put the clean towels in the cupboard nearest the bathroom.
entries.zh: 阿赫利娅把干净毛巾放在最靠近浴室的橱柜里。

entries.en: The family album contained photographs taken during a visit to Argentia.
entries.zh: 家庭相册里有几张到访阿真舍时拍的照片。

entries.en: Argentino carried the old carpet outside before sweeping the floor.
entries.zh: 阿亨蒂诺先把旧地毯搬到外面，再扫地。

entries.en: Argento checked the clasp before returning the bracelet to its box.
entries.zh: 阿尔真托检查了搭扣，再把手镯放回盒子。

entries.meaningZh: 阿尔戈号〔神话中的船名〕
entries.en: The illustrator drew Argo beside an imaginary coastline.
entries.zh: 插画师把神话中的阿尔戈号画在一条虚构的海岸线旁。

entries.en: His argumentativeness turned a simple planning meeting into a lengthy dispute.
entries.zh: 他的好辩把一次简单的筹划会议变成了漫长的争论。

entries.en: Argyris moved the heavy basket away from the uneven step.
entries.zh: 阿吉里斯把重篮子从不平的台阶旁挪开了。

entries.en: Argyropoulos kept the damaged picture flat until a new frame was ready.
entries.zh: 新画框准备好之前，阿伊罗普洛斯一直把受损的画平放着。

entries.en: Argyros placed the small seedlings where they would not be stepped on.
entries.zh: 阿吉罗斯把幼苗放在不会被踩到的地方。

entries.en: The museum displayed a painting of an arhat beside the carved figures.
entries.zh: 博物馆在雕刻人像旁展出了一幅阿罗汉画像。

entries.en: Ariadna kept the spare tent pegs in a separate cloth bag.
entries.zh: 阿里亚德娜把备用帐篷钉放在单独的布袋里。

entries.en: Ariana labelled the jars before putting them on the highest shelf.
entries.zh: 阿里安娜先给罐子贴好标签，再把它们放到最高的架子上。

entries.en: The history seminar discussed Arianism without endorsing its theological claims.
entries.zh: 历史研讨课讨论了阿里乌斯教，但没有认同其神学主张。

entries.en: Ariba kept the folded umbrellas in a stand beside the lift.
entries.zh: 有庭把收拢的雨伞放在电梯旁的伞架里。

entries.en: Running the small hotel was not a bed of roses during the winter.
entries.zh: 冬天经营那家小旅馆，日子并不称心如意。

entries.en: Missing that train proved a blessing in disguise when I met an old friend.
entries.zh: 错过那班火车却让我遇到一位老友，结果因祸得福。

entries.en: The factory's sudden closure came as a bolt from the blue.
entries.zh: 工厂突然关闭，犹如晴天霹雳。

entries.meaningZh: 要大小便的感觉〔委婉语〕
entries.en: A call of nature interrupted our long journey through the hills.
entries.zh: 我们长途翻越山地时，因有人想上厕所而中途停了下来。

entries.en: Changing the old agreement could open a can of worms.
entries.zh: 改动那份旧协议，可能引出一连串复杂的问题。

entries.en: Records are easily lost; the missing safety report is a case in point.
entries.zh: 记录很容易遗失；那份缺失的安全报告就是一个恰当的例子。

entries.en: A few days by the sea gave her a change of scene.
entries.zh: 在海边住上几天，让她换了个环境。

entries.term: a chip off the old block
entries.en: With his father's dry humour, Ben was a chip off the old block.
entries.zh: 本和父亲一样有冷幽默，很有其父之风。

entries.en: She kept a clean bill of health among her travel papers.
entries.zh: 她把健康证明书放在旅行文件中。

entries.en: The falling branch missed us, but it was a close shave.
entries.zh: 落下的树枝没有砸到我们，但我们确实是侥幸脱险。

entries.en: The new repair work is a cut above the previous attempt.
entries.zh: 这次的维修质量比上一次高出一等。

entries.en: The outdoor sale was a dead loss after the storm arrived.
entries.zh: 暴风雨袭来后，那场露天售卖彻底失败了。

entries.en: Repairing a bicycle is a different kettle of fish from building one.
entries.zh: 修自行车和造自行车完全是两回事。

entries.en: Our donation was a drop in the ocean compared with the cost of rebuilding.
entries.zh: 与重建所需的费用相比，我们的捐款只是九牛一毛。

entries.en: They insisted on a fair shake when negotiating the sale.
entries.zh: 他们在商谈这笔买卖时坚持要公平交易。

entries.en: This cramped flat is a far cry from the spacious house we left.
entries.zh: 这套拥挤的公寓与我们搬离的那栋宽敞房子相去甚远。

entries.en: Critics expected the band's success to be a flash in the pan.
entries.zh: 评论家预计那支乐队的成功只会是昙花一现。

entries.en: Despite the early lead, victory was not a foregone conclusion.
entries.zh: 尽管早早领先，胜利也并非已成定局。

entries.en: The manager gave us a free hand to redesign the waiting room.
entries.zh: 经理让我们放手重新设计等候室。

entries.en: You did me a good turn by finding that missing receipt.
entries.zh: 你找到了那张丢失的收据，帮了我一个大忙。

entries.en: The repeated power failure remains a hard nut to crack.
entries.zh: 反复停电的问题仍然很棘手。

entries.en: She bought a head of lettuce for the evening meal.
entries.zh: 她买了一棵生菜，准备用来做晚饭。

entries.en: The small guesthouse became a home from home during our training course.
entries.zh: 培训期间，那家小旅馆成了我们像家一样舒适的住处。

entries.en: Losing the grant was a kick in the teeth after months of work.
entries.zh: 忙碌了几个月却失去资助，是个突如其来的打击。

entries.en: Restoring the old roof would cost a king's ransom.
entries.zh: 修复那个旧屋顶需要花一大笔钱。

entries.en: Moving abroad without a job was a leap in the dark.
entries.zh: 还没有工作就搬到国外，是一次冒险。

entries.en: Finding the lost ring on the beach was a long shot.
entries.zh: 想在海滩上找到丢失的戒指，是个成功希望渺茫的尝试。

entries.en: The cottage is a long way from the nearest bus stop.
entries.zh: 那间村舍离最近的公交车站很远。

entries.en: He promised to return the tools, and he is a man of his word.
entries.zh: 他答应归还工具，而他是个守信用的人。

entries.en: As a man of the world, he doubted the stranger's generous offer.
entries.zh: 作为一个深通世故的人，他对陌生人的慷慨提议心存疑虑。

entries.en: Whether the ending improves the novel is a matter of opinion.
entries.zh: 这个结局是否让小说更好，是一个见仁见智的问题。

entries.en: The villain in the play is a nasty piece of work.
entries.zh: 剧中的反派是个品行恶劣的家伙。

entries.en: The repairs gave the old community hall a new lease of life.
entries.zh: 修缮让那座旧社区礼堂重新焕发了活力。

entries.en: Her supposed account of the accident was a pack of lies.
entries.zh: 她那番所谓的事故经过全是谎言。

entries.en: Re-entering the same details every morning is a pain in the ass.
entries.zh: 每天早上重复输入同样的信息，真是烦死人了。

entries.en: Keeping all those paper receipts is a pain in the neck.
entries.zh: 保管那一大堆纸质收据是件烦人的差事。

entries.en: The volunteers deserved a pat on the back for finishing so quickly.
entries.zh: 志愿者们完成得这么快，值得受到表扬。

entries.en: After the steep climb, the walk home was a piece of cake.
entries.zh: 爬过那段陡坡之后，走回家简直轻而易举。

entries.en: Temporary staff felt they had received a raw deal over holiday pay.
entries.zh: 临时员工觉得自己在假期工资方面受到了不公平的对待。

entries.en: There was a shade of doubt in his reply.
entries.zh: 他的回答中透出了一点疑虑。

entries.en: My estimate was a shot in the dark without the missing figures.
entries.zh: 缺少那些数字，我的估计只能是瞎猜。

entries.en: She needed a shoulder to cry on after the disappointing interview.
entries.zh: 那场令人失望的面试之后，她需要一个可以倾诉和依靠的人。

entries.en: The family's fear of scandal suggests a skeleton in the closet.
entries.zh: 那家人害怕丑闻，暗示他们有不可告人的家丑。

entries.en: The old letter hinted at a skeleton in the cupboard.
entries.zh: 那封旧信暗示了一件不可告人的家丑。

entries.en: The quarrel ended with a slap in the face.
entries.zh: 争吵以一记耳光告终。

entries.en: Calling the new manager by the old name was a slip of the tongue.
entries.zh: 把新经理叫成原来经理的名字，是一次口误。

entries.en: Spreading those false rumours was a stab in the back.
entries.zh: 散布那些虚假谣言，是在背后放暗箭伤人。

entries.en: The argument over the seating plan was a storm in a teacup.
entries.zh: 那场关于座位安排的争论，完全是小题大作。

entries.en: The fuss over one misplaced comma became a tempest in a teapot.
entries.zh: 大家为一个位置不当的逗号大动干戈，完全是小题大作。

entries.en: Paper tickets are a thing of the past on this bus route.
entries.zh: 这条公交线路上的纸质车票已经成为过去。

entries.en: Maya was a tower of strength for us throughout the difficult winter.
entries.zh: 那个艰难的冬天，玛雅一直是我们坚强的支柱。

entries.en: As a woman of the world, she recognized the empty promise immediately.
entries.zh: 作为一个深通世故的女人，她立刻识破了那个空头承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 线上推广〔大众媒体广告〕
entries.en: The campaign used television for above-the-line promotion.
entries.zh: 这次宣传活动通过电视进行大众媒体广告推广。

entries.en: She completed an access course before applying to study history.
entries.zh: 她先读完了高校入学补习课程，再申请学习历史。

entries.en: Our spare generator was an ace in the hole when the electricity failed.
entries.zh: 停电时，备用发电机成了我们的应急王牌。

entries.meaningZh: 酸屋音乐〔电子音乐风格〕
entries.en: The DJ played acid house during the last part of the evening.
entries.zh: 那天晚上的最后一段时间，DJ播放了酸屋音乐。

entries.en: He returned to university after leaving active duty.
entries.zh: 他退出现役后回到大学继续学习。

entries.en: The exhibition includes letters written during her years of active service.
entries.zh: 展览中包括她执行战时勤务期间写的信。

entries.meaningZh: 实际身体伤害〔法律用语〕
entries.en: The court heard the case involving an allegation of actual bodily harm.
entries.zh: 法院审理了这起涉及实际身体伤害指控的案件。

entries.en: I copied the new telephone number into my address book.
entries.zh: 我把新电话号码抄进了通讯录。

entries.en: The children spent the afternoon at the adventure playground beside the park.
entries.zh: 孩子们在公园旁的儿童游乐场玩了一下午。

entries.en: She wrote anonymously to the newspaper's advice column.
entries.zh: 她匿名写信给报纸的答疑解惑专栏。

entries.en: The advice columnist asked readers not to include identifying details.
entries.zh: 那位提供咨询的专栏作家请读者不要写下可识别身份的细节。

entries.meaningZh: 认同卡〔与组织关联的信用卡〕
entries.en: She asked which charity was linked to the affinity card.
entries.zh: 她询问这张认同卡关联的是哪家慈善机构。

entries.en: The shop's after-sales service included arranging a repair appointment.
entries.zh: 那家店的售后服务包括安排维修预约。

entries.en: The air freshener had spilled inside the shopping bag.
entries.zh: 空气清新剂洒在了购物袋里。

entries.en: The air pistol remained in its case during the club's equipment inspection.
entries.zh: 俱乐部检查器材时，那支气手枪一直放在盒子里。

entries.meaningZh: 乘机时的愤怒或暴力行为
entries.en: The documentary examined how cabin crews respond to air rage.
entries.zh: 纪录片探讨了客舱机组人员如何应对乘客的空中暴怒行为。

entries.en: The historical account describes an air strike that damaged the railway station.
entries.zh: 那份历史记载描述了一场损坏火车站的空袭。

entries.en: The pilot waited for instructions from air traffic control.
entries.zh: 飞行员等候空中交通管制部门的指示。

entries.en: The air traffic controller handed over to a colleague at the end of the shift.
entries.zh: 下班时，那位空中交通指挥员向同事交接了工作。

entries.en: Her old friends had little patience with her new airs and graces.
entries.zh: 老朋友们对她新出现的装腔作势很不耐烦。

entries.en: The village race welcomed all-comers, regardless of previous experience.
entries.zh: 村里的比赛欢迎所有人参赛，无论是否有过经验。

entries.en: Replacing the damaged windows cost us an arm and a leg.
entries.zh: 更换受损窗户花了我们一大笔钱。

entries.en: We listened to the proposal with an open mind.
entries.zh: 我们以开放的态度听取了这个提议。

entries.en: The students organized a discussion about animal rights.
entries.zh: 学生们组织了一场关于动物权利的讨论。

entries.en: When the delayed parcel will arrive is anybody's guess.
entries.zh: 那个延误的包裹什么时候能到，谁也说不准。

entries.en: The appeal court requested a copy of the original decision.
entries.zh: 上诉法院要求提供原判决的副本。

entries.en: The appeal tribunal heard statements from both parties.
entries.zh: 上诉法庭听取了双方的陈述。

entries.meaningZh: 少年罪犯感化院〔英国旧制〕
entries.en: The historian examined letters written by former pupils of an approved school.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了英国旧制少年感化院以前的学生所写的信。

entries.en: The training programme included an aptitude test before the practical workshop.
entries.zh: 培训项目在实操课之前安排了一次能力测试。

entries.en: The old arcade game still drew a crowd at the seaside café.
entries.zh: 那款老街机游戏仍能在海滨咖啡馆吸引一群人。

entries.en: The novel explores an arranged marriage through the experiences of both partners.
entries.zh: 小说通过双方的经历探讨了一桩包办婚姻。

entries.en: The seminar debated art for art's sake without reaching a shared conclusion.
entries.zh: 研讨课辩论了艺术至上主义，但没有达成共同结论。

entries.en: The recruits completed the assault course before the rain began.
entries.zh: 新兵们在下雨前完成了障碍训练场的训练。

entries.en: The asylum seeker asked for an interpreter before the interview.
entries.zh: 那位寻求避难者在面谈前请求提供口译员。

entries.en: A patient attitude of mind helped her cope with the repeated delays.
entries.zh: 耐心的思想态度帮助她应对了一次又一次的延误。

entries.en: The research seminar compared reports of avian flu from different years.
entries.zh: 研究研讨会比较了不同年份的禽流感报告。

entries.en: The singer's back catalogue includes several recordings made with a small orchestra.
entries.zh: 那位歌手的过往作品包括几段与小型管弦乐队合作完成的录音。

entries.en: I found the interview in a back issue of the magazine.
entries.zh: 我在那本杂志的一期旧刊中找到了那篇采访。

entries.en: The librarian located the missing article in a back number of the journal.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在那本期刊的一期旧刊中找到了缺失的文章。

entries.en: The patient described discomfort in the back passage during the consultation.
entries.zh: 病人在就诊时描述了直肠部位的不适。

entries.en: The workers received their back pay after a lengthy dispute.
entries.zh: 经过漫长的争议后，工人们拿到了拖欠的工资。

entries.en: We took a back road to avoid the traffic near the bridge.
entries.zh: 我们走了一条偏僻的乡间道路，避开桥边的车流。

entries.en: With his back to the wall, he finally asked his friends for help.
entries.zh: 走投无路之际，他终于向朋友们求助。

entries.en: The contractor denied offering a back-hander to secure the work.
entries.zh: 承包商否认曾为拿到工程而提供回扣。

entries.en: I stopped giving directions because I sounded like a back-seat driver.
entries.zh: 我不再指点路线，因为听起来像个不断指挥司机的乘客。

entries.en: Constant backbiting damaged trust within the small team.
entries.zh: 持续不断的背后中伤损害了这个小团队内部的信任。

entries.en: The solver used backtracking to explore a different branch after the first failed.
entries.zh: 第一个分支失败后，求解程序用回溯法探索了另一个分支。

entries.en: She waited until everyone was seated before sharing the bad news.
entries.zh: 她等大家都坐下后，才说出那个坏消息。

entries.en: We shared baked beans in tomato sauce on toast after the long walk.
entries.zh: 长途散步后，我们分着吃了配茄汁烘豆的吐司。

entries.en: She stored the bakeware on the lowest shelf of the kitchen cupboard.
entries.zh: 她把烘焙用具存放在厨房橱柜最下面的架子上。

entries.en: Leave enough space between the biscuits on the baking sheet.
entries.zh: 放到烤盘上的饼干之间要留出足够的空隙。

entries.en: Managing the small budget was a balancing act between repairs and new equipment.
entries.zh: 管理这笔小预算，需要兼顾维修与添置设备两方面。

entries.en: The ball girl returned the stray tennis ball to the player.
entries.zh: 女球童把飞出的网球交还给了球员。

entries.en: She folded the ballot paper before placing it in the box.
entries.zh: 她把选票折好，再投入票箱。

entries.en: The committee investigated allegations of ballot rigging in the local election.
entries.zh: 委员会调查了地方选举中有关操纵选票的指控。

entries.en: She added a little balsamic vinegar to the tomato salad.
entries.zh: 她在番茄沙拉里加了一点意大利香脂醋。
